rows.title: Backlog point bubbles and the Epic panel show point totals with floating-point noise ('0.30000000000000004')
rows.summary: Now: point totals are rounded to 2 decimals (boardQuery roundPoints) in issueStats (Epic panel, section stats, project summary) and in the new pointsByCategory that PointBubbles uses, so 0.1 + 0.2 reads 0.3 and 1.1 + 2.2 reads 3.3; whole and half points add as before.

issues: R5-HUNT9-REV-POINTS-ROUNDED-2DP: e814075b rounded every point total to a fixed 2 decimals, but an estimate is any number >= 0 (PointsInput keeps any decimal), so a lone 0.125-point issue read 0.13 in its section bubble while its own pill read 0.125, and a 0.004-point total read 0, which also hid the Epic panel points line (p.points falsy). Fixed: sumPoints rounds each sum to the most decimals any of its estimates has (the exact decimal total), still clearing float noise (0.1+0.2 -> 0.3, ten 0.1s -> 1).
review.notes: Original fix e814075b: root cause right (raw float sums in issueStats and PointBubbles), failfirst run 36644706908 green; issueStats covers Epic panel, sprint sections and sprintStats; no other point sums in src (list/board views show per-issue pills only). Review fix 9898465e: new test tests/unit/r5-hunt9-rev-points-precision.unit.mjs; run 36646510890: failfirst green (fail 3 without, pass with), tests (both hunt9 tests, tests/unit/board-*.unit.mjs, knowledge-docs) green, lint green. roundPoints export replaced by sumPoints (no other importers). No stored data, sync, undo or export touched: totals are computed on render.

notes: Base moved to 22fb602e (origin/claude/r4-green head at start). CI run 36644706908: failfirst green, tests (new test, board-query, knowledge-docs) green, lint green. No docs/knowledge text describes point totals, so no doc change.
